recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i app/build.gradle
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleRelease -PRELEASE_STORE_FILE=/dev/null -PRELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=pass -PRELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=alias -PRELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=pass
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
